descriptions.text: A user with a Twitter account named Amplify revealed that he made a profit of US$250,000 from a system vulnerability in the new DeFi project Soft Finance.

On September 3, 2020, Soft Yearn (SYFI) was exploited on Ethereum due to a faulty rebasing mechanism. The attacker turned a minor investment into over $250,000 by timing trades around a flawed supply adjustment in the SYFI token, draining the Uniswap liquidity pool. Soft Yearn’s rebase logic failed to synchronize token supply expansions with Uniswap pool accounting. This allowed a holder to immediately sell an inflated balance after supply adjustment, extracting liquidity before pool pricing adapted. Accounting for LP balances and rebased supply was not robust.
